name: Chase Hunter
source: Chase Hunter is an otter who grew up in the town of Echo who now studies Journalism at Pueblo University. Over spring break, he returns to his hometown to document an event in the town's history for a project. He is joined by five childhood friends who use the project as an excuse to have a reunion.
